user_query: I am planning a trip to New York City next month and I want to explore the local attractions and events. Can you recommend some popular tourist spots to visit and provide me with information about any upcoming public holidays during my stay? Additionally, I would like to get the latest news about the stock market and global indices to stay updated on the financial trends.

TaskList.description: Gather information on popular tourist spots in New York City.
Check for upcoming public holidays in New York City during the specified period.
Retrieve the latest news about the stock market and global indices.
